title: Weather
descriptionFa: انواع هوا، صفت‌های هوا (sunny, rainy…)، و حرف زدن درباره‌ی هوا.

words.example: What's the weather like in Mashhad in winter?
words.tipFa: غیرقابل‌شمارشه: nice weather، نه a nice weather.

words.example: The sun is very strong in Kish in summer.
The sun doesn't shine much in London in winter.
words.tipFa: گذشته: shone. The sun is shining = آفتابیه.

words.example: There was a lot of rain in Rasht last week.
words.tipFa: فعل هم هست: It's raining. صفت: rainy.

words.example: Children love playing in the snow.
words.tipFa: It's snowing = داره برف میاد. صفت: snowy.

words.example: There isn't a cloud in the sky today.
The fog was so thick that we couldn't see the road.
The wind blew my hat off.
The thunder woke the baby up.
Lightning hit a tall tree in our street.
words.tipFa: بدون e وسطش: lightning. صفت نداره.

words.example: It's sunny in Shiraz today.
words.tipFa: It's sunny، نه It's sunning. همین‌طور windy, cloudy, foggy.

words.example: Rasht is a rainy city.
We had a snowy winter in Tabriz this year.
It's cloudy, but it isn't raining.
It's very windy at the top of the mountain.
Drive slowly. It's foggy this morning.
It's forty-five degrees in Ahvaz today!
Spring in Shiraz is warm and sunny.
words.tipFa: warm از hot خنک‌تره و دلپذیره.

words.example: My shoes are wet because of the rain.
The desert is very dry.
The ships stayed in the port because of the storm.
We had a big thunderstorm last night.
The hurricane destroyed hundreds of houses.
What a lovely morning! Let's walk to work.
The weather was horrible all week.
